name: B-810 Infrared Sauna
description: Ideal for those having minimal space available and/or those using their sauna solo, the Model 810 has a footprint of only 9 sq. ft. With all the Premium Line features, The Model 810 has the same luxurious features as larger models but is packaged as our smallest model. "Lack of space” is no longer a limitation. This model can be installed into a corner of almost any room — even into a walk-in closet.
